result.summary: Sell a low-cost automation + setup service for restaurants/micro-restaurants that take orders via WhatsApp: turn WhatsApp orders into verified payments and receipts using CobrAMO for collection.
result.opportunity: Many small restaurants accept orders via WhatsApp/DM and lose sales or time because payments (bank transfers/QR) are manual and lack verification & receipt issuance. Automation that links order, proof, verification and receipt closes sales faster.
result.target_customer: Small restaurants, takeaway kitchens and food vendors that receive orders via WhatsApp or Instagram (1–10 daily orders), publicly listed on Google My Business/Instagram in Spain and LATAM.
result.offer: Setup Pro 'Pedidos->Cobro AMO': 1) WhatsApp-optimized payment instructions and DM assets; 2) n8n/Make/Zapier automation that captures proof, matches to orders, generates PDF receipt; 3) Google Sheet control + PDF receipt template; 4) 30-min remote setup & test; 5) 7-day support/recorded walkthrough.
result.price: €149 setup one-time + optional €29 first verified-payment confirmation (manual) as an add-on
result.why_now: High WhatsApp Business adoption among SMBs makes WhatsApp-first ordering common; businesses need fast, verifiable payment flows to avoid lost sales and disputes. CobrAMO provides proven payment rails to accept and verify receipts.
actions_completed: Reviewed repository session context and previous IAMO attempts summary
Fetched WhatsApp Business product page as external evidence
Fetched Statista topic page related to WhatsApp usage

execution_packet.channel: Direct message or email using the restaurant's publicly listed contact (Google My Business / Instagram contact info). Do NOT use CobrAMO contacts as prospects.
execution_packet.subject: Automatiza pedidos y cobros por WhatsApp — setup rápido + recibos (RANK-IAMO20)
execution_packet.message: Hola — Soy un servicio técnico que automatiza pedidos por WhatsApp y convierte comprobantes en recibos profesionales en minutos. Entrego: automatización (n8n/Make/Zapier), plantilla de recibo PDF y 30-min setup remoto. Precio: €149 setup; opcion de confirmación manual del primer pago €29. Pago por CobrAMO: https://cobramo.netlify.app/ — usar referencia RANK-IAMO20 al pagar. ¿Podemos agendar 20–30 min para ver su flujo actual?
execution_packet.deliverable: Deployed automation (n8n/Make/Zapier config), Google Sheet control, PDF receipt template, recorded walkthrough video, test payment verification using CobrAMO.

result.expected_revenue_eur: €149.00 per converted restaurant (estimation, not claimed revenue)
result.differentiation_from_previous: Focuses on restaurants (distinct niche), delivers technical automation (not only templates), higher-ticket one-time setup (€149) with a small verification upsell, acquisition via public listings (Google My Business/Instagram) rather than CobrAMO contacts, and includes recorded walkthrough for low-support overhead.
result.next_step: Contact 15–25 local restaurants (publicly listed contacts) with the provided message, record responses, book setup calls with willing payers, and collect payments via CobrAMO using reference RANK-IAMO20.
result.notes: Assumes restaurants have WhatsApp or public contact listed and accept online payment links or transfers via CobrAMO; risk: manual outreach needed to close sales and some clients may prefer existing workflows. Legal/compliance: no regulated services offered. Keep outreach personal and limited; avoid spam.
